# gdpr spec

**Feature**: GDPR end-to-end coverage — cookie-consent banner, consent API, privacy policy page, admin data-export / data-deletion-request forms, data-request management incl. the erasure lifecycle, audit logs, data retention, and the privacy-policy editor
**Generated by**: Playwright Planner Agent
**App**: Scriptlog, PHP >= 7.4, MVC, Bootstrap 4, jQuery
**Bootstrap**: use `e2e/seed.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.js` (baseURL `http://127.0.0.1:8099`, DB `blogware_e2e`, 3 browser projects, `workers: 1`)
**Phase**: GDPR remediation plan — N-series

---

## Purpose

Verify every GDPR surface end to end: the consent banner records a choice and persists it; the
consent API rejects bad input; the privacy page renders localized policy content; the admin data
export streams a JSON download; deletion requests are created, rate-limited, and audited; the
data-request management page drives the pending→processing→completed lifecycle including the
irreversible-erasure confirmation guard; retention cleanup removes only old records; and the
policy editor performs CRUD reflected on the public page.

---

## URLs

| Route | Expected |
|-------|----------|
| `/` (and `/blog`) | 200, consent banner in footer, hidden until JS shows it |
| `POST /api/v1/gdpr/consent` `{"status":"accepted"\|"rejected"}` | 200, success envelope |
| `POST /api/v1/gdpr/consent` invalid status | 400 `INVALID_STATUS` |
| `PUT/DELETE /api/v1/gdpr/consent` | 405 `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` |
| `GET /api/v1/gdpr/consent` | 200 `{consent_given, consent_type}` |
| `/privacy` (and `/?privacy`) | 200, localized policy content |
| `admin/index.php?load=privacy&p=data-export` | 200 (authed), JSON download on valid submit |
| `admin/index.php?load=privacy&p=data-deletion` | 200 (authed), request created; rate-limited 5/15min/IP |
| `admin/index.php?load=privacy&p=data-requests` | 200 (authed), request table + lifecycle actions |
| `admin/index.php?load=privacy&p=audit-logs` | 200 (authed), audit table |
| `admin/index.php?load=privacy&p=retention` | 200 (authed), retention settings + cleanup |
| `admin/index.php?load=privacy-policy` | 200 (authed), policy editor CRUD |
| Unauthenticated / non-admin access to any privacy page | redirect to `login.php` / 403 `load=403` |

---

## Preconditions

- `blogware_e2e` DB reachable; admin account ID **767** `administrator` / `$E2E_ADMIN_PASS` (see `e2e/.env.example`) — never
  erased, never the erasure subject, and always present as the fallback author (user ID 1 is
  absent, so `resolveFallbackAuthorId()` returns 767).
- Disposable GDPR subject: `gdpr_user` / `gdpr.test@e2e.local` / `$E2E_GDPR_PASS` (author level),
  with one authored post (`GDPR E2E Post`) and one comment, and a `processing` deletion request.
- Disposable low-privilege user: `noaccess_user` / `noaccess@e2e.local` / `$E2E_NOACCESS_PASS`.
- Seed SQL must be idempotent and run in each spec's `beforeAll`; `afterAll`/`afterEach` cleans up
  disposable rows only (see Data Cleanup below). All traffic is `127.0.0.1`, so state is
  shared/IP-keyed — delete `tbl_consents`, `tbl_data_requests`, `tbl_privacy_logs`, and the
  `public/cache/rate_limit/*.ratelimit` files before rate-limit-sensitive tests.
- CSRF tokens are single-use — re-read the fresh token after every POST in multi-POST tests.
- Admin login helper submits the real rendered form (`#inputLogin`, `#inputPassword`,
  `input[name="LogIn"]`) and only ever uses correct credentials so the ≥5-failed-attempt captcha
  never appears; `DELETE FROM tbl_login_attempt WHERE ip_address='127.0.0.1'` in `beforeEach`.
- HTML5 `required`/`type=email` inputs must have `form.noValidate = true` set before server-side
  negative submits.

---

## User Actions

- First visit: banner appears after ~500ms; Accept / Reject record a cookie + POST the API and
  hide the banner; banner stays hidden on reload.
- Learn More navigates to the privacy policy; `[data-cookie-settings]` resets consent and re-shows
  the banner.
- Admin export: enter a valid email, select comment/post/activity scopes, submit → JSON file
  downloads.
- Admin deletion request: valid email + reason → success notice + `pending` request row.
- Data requests page: Process → Processing; Complete (with `confirm_erasure` for erasure/deletion)
  → Completed (triggers anonymization + account deletion); Reject → Rejected.
- Retention: set windows, save; run cleanup with confirmation → old consent/log rows removed.
- Policy editor: create, edit, set-default, delete localized policies.

---

## Expected Behaviour

- Consent is versioned: a mismatched `cookie_consent_version` re-shows the banner even when an
  `accepted` cookie exists.
- `GET consent` reports `consent_given: true` only when an `accepted` row exists for the IP;
  `rejected` rows never count.
- Erasure is transactional and irreversible: the subject user is deleted, the comment is
  anonymized, the post is reassigned to the fallback author (767), and a `data_deleted` audit row
  is written — all or nothing.
- Completing an erasure request without checking `confirm_erasure` is blocked with a guard error
  and the request stays `processing`.
- Non-admin roles get 403 and never see privacy UI (server-side `userAccessControl(PRIVACY)`).
- Retention cleanup removes only records older than the configured window.

---

## Validation Rules

- Banner visible: `await expect(page.locator('#cookie-consent-banner')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 3000 })`.
- Consent API POST: capture via `page.waitForResponse`; assert 200, `data.status`, and a matching
  `tbl_consents` row by IP.
- Downloads: `page.waitForEvent('download')`; assert `suggestedFilename()` matches
  `/^user_data_\d+\.json$/` and parse `await download.path()`.
- DB assertions via mysql CLI (`execFileSync`), mirroring the repo's `fs`-based cleanup pattern.
- Negative forms: `await form.evaluate(f => { f.noValidate = true; })` before submitting.
- Timestamps/labels asserted with regex, never exact `datetime` strings.

---

## UI Components

- Banner: `#cookie-consent-banner` (`role=dialog`, `aria-labelledby`/`aria-describedby`),
  `.cookie-btn-accept`, `.cookie-btn-reject`, `.cookie-btn-learn-more`, data attrs
  `data-privacy-url`, `data-api-endpoint`, `data-consent-lifetime`, `data-consent-version`.
- Consent cookies: `cookie_consent` ∈ {accepted, rejected}, `cookie_consent_version` (= `1`),
  SameSite=Lax.
- Admin login: `#inputLogin`, `#inputPassword`, `input[name="LogIn"]`, hidden `csrf` + honeypots.
- Export form: `input[name="export_email"]`, `export_comments`, `export_posts`, `export_activity`,
  hidden `csrfToken`, submit `Request Data Export`.
- Deletion form: `input[name="delete_email"]`, `textarea[name="delete_reason"]`, `confirm_delete`,
  hidden `csrfToken`, submit `Request Data Deletion`.
- Data requests: `#scriptlog-table`, type labels (Data Access / Rectification / Erasure / Deletion),
  status labels (Pending / Processing / Completed / Rejected), buttons `Process` / `Complete` /
  `Reject`, erasure checkbox `input[name="confirm_erasure"]`.
- Retention: `#consent_retention_days`, `#privacy_log_retention_days`, `save_retention`,
  `run_cleanup`, `confirm_cleanup`.
- Policy editor: `#policyTable`, `#policyForm` with `#locale`, `#policy_title`, `#policy_content`,
  `is_default`; buttons `Create Policy` / `Update Policy` / `Edit` / `Set Default` / `Delete`
  (register `page.on('dialog', d => d.accept())` for the confirm dialogs).

---

## Security Expectations

- Consent endpoint requires no auth but validates status strictly (400 invalid, 405 wrong method).
- Every state-changing admin form carries a CSRF token; forged/missing tokens are rejected.
- Erasure requires explicit confirmation; it is only ever run against the disposable subject user.
- Authorization enforced server-side: non-administrators cannot reach privacy UI (403).
- Data-export and deletion-request endpoints are rate-limited per IP.

---

## Test Scenarios (prioritized)

Critical:
- Banner renders, Accept/Reject persist cookies + POST the API, banner hidden on reload.
- Consent API: accepted → 200 + row; invalid status → 400; wrong method → 405.
- Erasure lifecycle with confirmation: user deleted, comment anonymized, post reassigned to 767.
- Erasure without `confirm_erasure` is blocked and request stays `processing`.
- Admin-only privacy access: anonymous → login redirect; editor/author → 403.

High:
- Data export streams a valid JSON download and writes an audit log.
- Deletion request happy path + per-IP rate limit (5/15 min).
- Request lifecycle pending → processing → completed, and reject flow.
- Retention cleanup removes only old consent/log rows; unconfirmed cleanup is blocked.
- Policy editor CRUD reflected on the public `/privacy` page.
